title: Student Section Congress
tagline: The section-wide student leadership congress of IEEE Hyderabad SAC.
short_description: The section-level student congress bringing together IEEE student branches, leaders, volunteers, and industry voices across the Hyderabad Section.
long_description: Student Section Congress is a flagship IEEE Hyderabad SAC platform focused on leadership, networking, student branch development, technical sessions, cultural exchange, and recognition of volunteer contributions. It gives students a larger stage to learn from IEEE leaders, collaborate across branches, and strengthen the volunteer ecosystem.
highlights: Networking with IEEE volunteers and section leaders
